findings.title: Directive control group still received the directive

findings.title: Role instruction capture and skill addenda

findings.title: Tool sandbox is opt-in and backend-dependent

findings.title: Structural evidence references are not independently executed proof

findings.title: Cheap deterministic decisions before model arbitration
